directories.description: Baseline, compile-unit and resolved configuration metadata.
Call/dependency graphs derived from extracted facts.
Reusable semantic TU cache; entries are fingerprinted and may be reused by resume.
Retained failed raw shards, diagnostics and extractor indexes; successful shards are normally discarded.

know_how: Treat kb/ and manifest/ as deterministic extraction evidence; do not edit them manually.
Treat indexes/ and reports/ as derived review surfaces. They can be regenerated from the canonical KB and manifest configuration.
Exact API catalog hits are high-confidence classification hints, regex family hits are coverage hints, and compiler/AST facts remain authoritative for calls and locations.
Base prompts are rendered from external templates referenced by the input manifest; change templates/configuration and rerun rather than editing generated prompts.
Use the same input manifest for the orchestrator so policy, templates and semantic categories remain consistent.
Start downstream analysis with architecture; method/file/subsystem/final gates are enforced by the orchestrator.
Successful translation units are cached by semantic input fingerprint; use resume after a failed run to reuse matching TU results without rerunning bootstrap.
manifest/extraction_quality.json and manifest/run_state.json are the validity gate; physical downstream files from an older run are not current unless the active run is COMPLETE/PASS.
manifest/extraction_checkpoint.json is operational provenance, not semantic source truth; it records progress/cache reuse and can change without staling accepted engineering analysis.

next_steps.why: Inspect TU failures, cache/checkpoint state, resource signals and extraction quality before downstream analysis.
Retry only invalid/missing TUs without bootstrap; reuse successful semantic TU cache entries when identities still match.
Create schema-validated orchestration inventory, registries, traceability and stage gates.
Use this file as the single exitpoint for all produced artifacts.

Enriched stage prompts generated from validated upstream results.

know_how: Start with output_manifest.json; it indexes rather than embeds project artifacts.
Generated base knowledge remains immutable; orchestrated results are provenance-checked derivatives.
All prompts and record templates come from the template index referenced by the input manifest.
All stage policy comes from the orchestration policy files referenced by the same input manifest.
Method agents may propose requests/risks; file agents must explicitly disposition owned items; project items remain open until final resolution.
A result that becomes stale after upstream change must be re-rendered/re-ingested rather than manually patched in place.

next_steps.why: Advance the next incomplete stage whose configured gate is ready.
Review gate blockers, coverage, evidence and staleness before running additional agents.
